subject: general
question: Two circles with a common center (concentric circles) have radii of 5 cm and 12 cm. A tangent to the inner circle forms a chord of the outer circle. What is the length of this chord?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Length of chord in outer circle which is tangent to inner circle = 2 × √(R² − r²)

Given: Outer radius (R) = 12 cm, Inner radius (r) = 5 cm

Chord Length = 2 × √(12² − 5²) = 2 × √(144 − 25) = 2 × √119

Chord Length ≈ 2 × 10.9 = 21.8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the outer circle (R) = 12 cm

Radius of the inner circle (r) = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a right-angled triangle formed by the radii and the chord: R² = r² + (L/2)²

Where L is the length of the chord.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05ea1767ffe0ca8d1e327ed7888e97a0010026b4a9d62946f5706699beea347a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In the right triangle, the radius of the inner circle is perpendicular to the chord.

⇒ (Chord/2)² = R² − r²

⇒ (Chord/2)² = 12² − 5²

⇒ (Chord/2)² = 144 − 25

⇒ (Chord/2)² = 119

⇒ Chord/2 = √119 ≈ 10.9087 cm

⇒ Chord length = 2 × 10.9087 ≈ 21.817 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent-Radius Property

A tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact (Angle = 90°).

Chord Bisection Rule

A perpendicular drawn from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord into two equal segments.

Pythagoras Theorem in Circles

For a chord of length L at distance d from the center of a circle with radius R: R² = d² + (L/2)².</p
